title: Response
description: A response to a prior request. id REQUIRED (echoes the originating request); ok boolean REQUIRED; payload open for the spike. Frozen from docs/seed.md §Response example ({id, ok:true, payload:{clipId, notes}}).
$comment: Phase 1 freezes the response envelope shape only ({id, ok, payload}). The payload discriminated union (per originating request type) is Phase 2 — tightening now would lock guesses (Pitfall 4). ok=false responses carry an error payload shape defined in Phase 2.

id.description: Echoes the originating request id. REQUIRED.

ok.description: Success flag. REQUIRED on every response.

payload.description: Response payload. Open for the spike; tightened per request type in Phase 2.
